g.text: Inferred archive shifts choices only with thinking;
readable rubric shifts them in both modes
No evaluation framing · eight paired bases × three seeds per cell
Customer mildly prefers one option; either is acceptable.
Counts are descriptive; seeds within a base are not independent scenarios.
All displayed choices parsed. Paired base-bootstrap margin intervals are reported in the text.
